Subject: Co-host invitation — short webinar on inference cost optimization (proposed dates)

Hi Annie —

Great to speak last week. CloudForge + Redwood feels like a natural pairing for a concise, technical webinar that helps platform engineers choose inference patterns that reduce cost without sacrificing latency. We’d love to co-host and promote together.

Proposed format (30–40 minutes):
- 20 min: short keynote + demo (Redwood & CloudForge integration patterns)
- 10–15 min: customer example / Q&A

Target audience: infra/platform engineers at mid-market SaaS (AWS/GCP), DevRel/ML infra leads.

Possible live dates: Feb 22, Mar 7, Mar 14. Do any of these work for CloudForge?

I attached a first-pass invite copy (invite_copy_v2.docx) and a rough audience seed (target_segments_q1.csv). If you’re open, we’ll share a tracking plan and RSVP cadence next week.

Thanks —
